title: The Field house's conservatory, in glass
items: The conservatory on the south side of 1905 Prairie, Marshall Field's house, is now glass, as the 1893 Pictorial Chicago plate shows it: a ring of tall lights on fine bars, standing on a stone sill over the house's stone base, under a ribbed glass roof that curves up to the wall.
Until now it was a brick bow with three windows under a flat tin roof.
